capacity_audit.fixed_target_support: any bounded set of fixed h- or fixed s-targets occupies O(1) rows and O(log M)=o(M) raw mass at fixed M
capacity_audit.growing_target_height: log numerator(b_h)=O(h) and log numerator(j_s)=O(s), but summing componentwise bounds over Theta(M) moving rows gives O(M^2)

denominator_support.actual_prime_unit: every actual p>=13 is a unit for both denominator sets
denominator_support.b_h: b_h is in Z[1/6]: psi=F^(2/3) satisfies psi^3=F^2; recursively 3 psi_n lies in Z[1/6] once earlier coefficients do
denominator_support.j_s: j_s is in Z[1/6]: N_s is in (1/3)Z[t], the negative integral power is integral, and the half-binomial coefficients have only powers of 2 in their denominators

integer_even_normalization.integrality: kappa_(M,h)=[u^(2h)](1-2sqrt(2)u+3u^2-sqrt(2)u^3)^(4M) is an integer because every even-degree monomial has an even total sqrt(2) parity
